S09.meta: // SLIDE 09 — LIQUID BIOPSY LIMITS: CHIP CONFOUNDING

data.question: DNMT3A flagged in plasma ctDNA — is this a tumor signal?

branches.label: Tumor signal interpretation
branches.detail: DNMT3A is present in plasma — mutation is real (analytic validity cleared)

branches.label: Clonal hematopoiesis (CHIP)
branches.detail: In patients over 60, aging blood cell progenitors carry DNMT3A, TET2, ASXL1, TP53 — indistinguishable from tumor without separately sequencing white blood cells
branches.fix: Sequence germline/WBC separately to distinguish CHIP from tumor signal

resolver.label: DNMT3A fails clinical validity as a lung marker
resolver.detail: Most likely source is aging white blood cells, not tumor. The test cleared analytic validity but fails clinical validity for lung cancer. Enthusiasm for the report is not evidence of utility.
